cand.title: OENOVITI International Symposium and General Assembly 2027
cand.organizationName: OENOVITI International Network, hosted by Changins and Agroscope
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified commercially relevant network contacts: Pierre-Louis Teissedre, Head/Coordinator of OENOVITI International; Agathe Lairy and Marie Arduin, named OENOVITI International Network Team contacts in the 2026 official programme. The Coordination Office is explicitly the main contact for event organization. Their role is a credible introduction/routing pathway, not verified hotel-contract authority for 2027. No named 2027 housing manager or local procurement buyer was established.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced for 19–21 May 2027 in Nyon, Switzerland; theme: “Viticulture 2030: Addressing environmental, social and human challenges”. These are activity dates, not publication dates. Agroscope lists Changins as the location and registration opening on 1 December 2026. The edition is upcoming as of 16 November 2026 and falls within the requested horizon. No official 2028 dates, city or venue were found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: YOTEL Geneva Lake in Founex is geographically plausible for Nyon/La Côte participant accommodation, but is not the published departure/return hotel. Target optional individual bookings or a modest sub-group, subject to transfer practicality and actual demand. Historical context only: the organizer reported 97 participants in Porto in 2026; this is neither a 2027 forecast nor a room count. The supplied 237-room inventory and meeting capacity could accommodate a mid-size ancillary gathering, but the symposium venue is already Changins and no off-site meeting/F&B requirement is published. Do not underwrite a 20–120-room block or whole-house demand without evidence. This is an academic/city-corridor lodging thesis, not a resort-retreat requirement or Palexpo overflow case.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Changins, hosted jointly by Changins | Haute école de viticulture et œnologie and Agroscope. Changins publishes Route de Duillier 50, 1260 Nyon. City: Nyon; region: Vaud / La Côte; country: Switzerland. This is in the hotel’s primary Nyon/La Côte territory, not downtown Geneva or Lausanne. The academic venue is announced, not a competing hotel; no signed venue contract or specific 2027 room/auditorium is published in the retrieved text.
findings.historicalRotation: Main annual editions rotate internationally: Japan (Kyoto/Yamanashi/Niigata), 11–15 May 2023; Asti, Italy, 14–15 May 2024; Vienna, Austria, 22–23 May 2025; Porto, Portugal, 20–22 May 2026; then Nyon, Switzerland, 19–21 May 2027. OENOVITI explicitly describes the Symposium and General Assembly as annual activities; online Mini-Symposia/Sprint Meetings are a separate format. International recurrence does not establish annual Swiss lodging demand or a Swiss return in 2028.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Participant-direct booking, with an edition-specific incumbent recommendation. OENOVITI states: “OENOVITI Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings” and recommends “Hôtel B&B NYON - 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon”; “Activities will depart and return to this location.” Corporate code: NOVITI27. Agroscope expressly adds: “You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs.” Hôtel B&B NYON is the only hotel named in the reviewed 2027 accommodation instructions. No contracted allotment, guaranteed room block, rate, release date, housing bureau or accommodation RFP is published. Recommendation/code and a transport meeting point are verified; exclusivity and contracted inventory are not.
findings.organizationStructure: An international academic/research and industry network, administered by an Executive Committee; its Bordeaux-based Coordination Office handles event organization and member communication. ADERA supports network financial administration and project management. The 2027 co-organizers are OENOVITI International, Agroscope and Changins. Treat as an association/network-led academic event, not a scaling-company corporate meeting. No PCO, DMC or housing agency is identified in the reviewed edition materials.
findings.competitiveLimitations: B&B NYON has an edition-specific recommendation, identification code NOVITI27 and the operational advantage of all activities departing/returning there. Participants may choose alternatives, so this is not proven exclusive housing. No sold-out notice, unmet demand, overflow allocation or YOTEL transport/booking relationship was found. No 2027 attendance, peak-room or room-night figure is published in the reviewed official materials.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Before the published 1 December 2026 registration opening, approach Agathe Lairy/Marie Arduin through oenoviti@u-bordeaux.fr, with Pierre-Louis Teissedre as senior sponsor, to request introduction to the 2027 local logistics lead. Acknowledge B&B NYON and ask whether YOTEL may be offered as an optional participant-paid alternative, not a replacement main venue. Ask for expected residential participants, arrival/departure pattern, existing hotel allotment/exclusivity if any, and pickup rules. Offer a conditional rate/availability proposal with a workable transfer plan only after these answers; ask about ancillary small-group/F&B needs without assuming any. Pursue future local relationships separately from unannounced future editions.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 main venue is announced and a lodging recommendation is already in place. Nevertheless, explicit freedom to choose alternative accommodation leaves a participant-paid alternative-hotel pathway. Organizer endorsement, a secondary hotel listing, group allocation and transfers for YOTEL remain unconfirmed; do not label hotel sourcing open. Registration is scheduled to open 1 December 2026.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop a Changins/Agroscope and OENOVITI coordination relationship for future local workshops or a later Swiss-hosted edition, and seek consideration before accommodation guidance is set. International historical rotation and annual recurrence do not confirm another Nyon edition. No 2028 local accommodation opportunity can presently be dated or quantified.
